title: Asset
description: An image or document attached to an entity. Designed for extensibility: entityType can be 'horse', 'owner', 'trainer', 'hlt', or 'marketplace'. Step 1 only uses 'horse'.

entityType.description: The type of entity this asset belongs to. Step 1 only uses 'horse'.

entityId.description: The ID of the entity. For horses, this is the microchip number.

assetType.description: Whether this is an image or a document.

gcsUrl.description: Full GCS URL to the asset file.

publicUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL for the asset (via signed URL or CDN).

thumbnailUrl.description: URL to a resized thumbnail version. Generated on upload.

fileName.description: Meaningful file name generated from context. Pattern: {horse-slug}_{date}_{context}_{seq}.{ext}

originalFileName.description: Original file name as uploaded by the user.

tags.description: Searchable tags for the asset. Auto-generated from horse name, owner, trainer, location, and context.

context.description: Free-text description of what's happening in the asset. e.g. 'morning training work at Wexford'

location.description: Location where the asset was captured.

isPrimary.description: Whether this is the primary image for the entity. Only one primary per entity.
